Name: Custom NPC Ivaras
Author: starfyzz
Description:
[center][img width=500,height=500]https://file.garden/ahsdhQ409mxcf5wP/IMG_0287.gif[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://file.garden/ahsdhQ409mxcf5wP/tumblr_32b1982f12d05af01b80abe0603f7d29_35951030_500.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img width=400,height=200]https://file.garden/ahsdhQ409mxcf5wP/phonto.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[quote]He is a young man trying his best to succeed in his arcane pursuits, even when the odds are against him. Acting as Rasmodius’ apprentice, Ivaras is often found within the tower and the surrounding forest. After their first meeting, he finds himself longing for a visit from his favorite farmer as the seasons pass and his affections grow.[/quote][center][/center]
[center][img]https://file.garden/ahsdhQ409mxcf5wP/tumblr_32b1982f12d05af01b80abe0603f7d29_35951030_500.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img width=400,height=200]https://file.garden/ahsdhQ409mxcf5wP/Inclusions.png[/img][/center]

This mod includes most everything that comes with a standard bachelor in the vanilla game, such as:

[list]
[*]An event at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 14 hearts[/*]
[*]Numerous animations and portraits[/*]
[*]Plentiful marriage dialogue, as well as a spouse room and patio[/*]
[*]A schedule for each season that varies depending on the day of the week, rain/green rain, the Night Market, and marriage[/*]
[*]Responses to each movie[/*]
[*]Festival inclusions, but note that he will NOT be present at the Egg Festival, the Desert Festival, Winter Star Feast, or the Luau[/*]
[*]Children with his hair color[/*]
[/list]This mod is 1.6 and SVE compatible. I also recommend playing the ten-heart event BEFORE getting married, but, by all means, play it how you like.

[b][u]No AI was used during the creation of this mod in any capacity. I also do not consent to my work being fed to AI, so please refrain.[/u][/b]

[left][b][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher and Smapi. The SVE version requires Stardew Valley Expanded.[/*]
[*]Compatible with the following mods:[/*]
[/list]     - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] by Omegasis
     - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42024]Coffee Roaster[/url] by HarrisonGrey
     - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Rasmodia[/url], as long as you download @TreyToore's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50040]compatibility patch[/url]
[center][img width=100,height=100]https://file.garden/ahsdhQ409mxcf5wP/IMG_0289.gif[/img]
[i][b]Heart Events: [/b][/i][/center]
[code][spoiler]
2 Heart Event
Requirements: the Wizard’s tower between 1 PM and 7 PM

4 Heart Event
Requirements: the forest, any day BUT Fri or Sun, between 8 AM and Noon. Will only activate four or more days after the 2 heart event

6 Heart Event
Requirements: the Wizard’s tower, between 1 PM and 7 PM. Will only activate four or more days after the 4 heart event

8 Heart Event
Requirements: the forest during rainy weather, between 5 PM and 8 PM. Will only activate four or more days after the 6 heart event

10 Heart Event
Requirements: the Saloon on any Friday, between 8 PM and 12 AM. Will only activate four or more days after the 8 heart event

14 Heart Event:
Requirements: being married, the Wizard’s tower, between 4 PM and 8 PM. Will only activate four or more days after the 10 heart event

[/spoiler][/code]

[center][b][i]Schedule:[/i][/b][/center]
[code][spoiler]
Keep in mind that he may be walking to said locations right at the time changes. This may be updated in the future so make sure to check back in after a new release.

Spring, Mon, Wed, Sun:
6 AM - 1 PM: Wizard Tower
1 PM - 5:30 PM: Cindersap Forest, near the hat mouse
5:30 PM onward: in his room

Tuesdays, all seasons:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower until bedtime

Thursdays, all seasons:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower until bedtime

Fridays:
6 AM - 8:10 AM: in the Wizard tower
8:10 AM - 1 PM: on the dock over the Cindersap Forest pond
1 PM - 5:30 PM: near the traveling cart
5:30 PM onward: in his room

Saturdays:
6 AM - 3 PM: various locations within the Wizard Tower
3 PM - 6:30 PM: on the dock over the Cindersap Forest pond
6:30 PM onward: in his room

Summer, Mon, Wed, Sun:
6 AM - 9 AM: various locations within the Wizard Tower
9 AM - 3 PM: southern tip of the small island south of Leah’s cabin (where you catch the Glacierfish)
3 PM - 7:30 PM: in his room

Fall, Mon, Wed, Sun:
6:30 AM - 7:30 AM PM: in the Wizard Tower
7:30 AM - 10:30 AM: by the pink tree in the Cindersap Forest
10:30 PM - 3 PM: on the dock over the Cindersap Forest pond
3 PM Onward: in the Wizard tower

Winter, Mon, Wed, Sun:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower

Winter 16 (Night Market Day 2):
6 AM - 3 PM: various locations within the Wizard Tower
3 PM - 10 PM: standing by the free coffee lady on the dock
10 PM onward: walking back to the tower

Rain:
In various locations within the Wizard Tower
[/spoiler][/code]
